assertion: Stratum-keyed, evidence-anchored ApoB target/band thresholds (mg/dL) used for banding, gap-to-target, score contribution and all Ch.4 discordance.
Combined biological + analytical variation below which an ApoB delta is not a significant trend change.
Time window after an acute event during which an ApoB value is tagged acute_context (reduced confidence, trend-excluded).

Gap-to-target (mg/dL) at which the ApoB score contribution reaches zero. Defines the slope of the continuous monotonic score introduced by amendment A-001. Required because A-001 replaced the band-keyed score with a continuous function of gap-to-target, which needs a scale.
Gap-to-target ceiling above which a lifestyle recommendation must escalate to clinician discussion.
ApoB value below which the low-ApoB investigation routing pathway activates (never a lipid warning, never a score penalty).
Age-stratified ApoB threshold(s) defining the familial-hypercholesterolaemia pattern. FOUNDER DECISION: sensitivity/specificity trade-off (BLOCKER-009 / DL-6.1).
LDL-C band thresholds (belongs to the LDL-C biomarker document). Required for ApoB/LDL-C discordance detection.
Versioned, maintained list of lipid drug names the narrative validator must never emit (enforces the no-drug-names prohibition).
Versioned, maintained list of condition/gene/instrument names the narrative validator must never emit (enforces FH naming-prohibition, DR-6.2-B).
